limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not occurred.
No synthesis or board verification performed.
justified_rtl_changes: Initial implementation uses exactly three states tracking no prefix, 1, and 10; detection is combinational on state 10 and x=1. The transition after detection retains prefix 1 to support overlap. Active-low reset asynchronously returns to the no-prefix state. No RTL revisions.
justified_tb_changes: Initial independent oracle compares the two previously sampled bits and current input, checking before and after clock edges. Exhaustively tests all 256 eight-bit streams plus input changes without clock edges and asynchronous reset while clock is low and high. No testbench revisions.
interface_cycle_contract: Original clk, aresetn, x, z ports; positive-edge state updates, negative-edge asynchronous reset, combinational Mealy output; no added latency.
static_review: Three enum states, complete combinational assignments, nonblocking sequential state update, explicit if/else next-state selection; two-bit state storage.
